title: Colorwork
yarn: #4 acrylic or cotton in several colors
summary: Tapestry, corner-to-corner graphs with bobbins, mosaic and planned pooling, ending in a tapestry tote of your own design.
intro: Optional elective. It is not part of the required path, and nothing required waits on it. It covers the four main ways crochet makes pictures with color. Toy-specific color work (stripes in the round, tapestry and intarsia in the round) is already in TOY 120 and TOY 310; take this course for flat colorwork and charted design. Chart first, swatch second, and deal with tails as you go.
outcomes: You can work a tapestry motif that matches its chart with the carried color hidden at arm's length.
You can work a C2C graph with bobbins so every tile matches the graph and no carried strand shows.
You can work overlay and inset mosaic from a chart.
You can plan pooling to get 20 rows of unbroken argyle.
You can chart and make an original tapestry tote whose motif repeats meet at the round start.
assessment: Each unit passes on its pass list. The tapestry tote (4.5) is the course project.

4.3: Every dropped-down stitch lands exactly where the chart says
You work one 20-stitch overlay swatch and one inset swatch from the same chart, and both match the chart stitch for stitch
